content.content: Skladba "Start Me Up - Remastered 2009" od legendárnej skupiny The Rolling Stones je ikonickým dielom rockovej hudby. alternatives.text: "Start Me Up," the lead single from The Rolling Stones' 1981 album *Tattoo You*, is a masterful blend of classic rock and hard rock elements. Keith Richards' distinctive guitar riffs and Mick Jagger's charismatic vocals create an infectious, self-assured melody. This timeless track, with its bold bravado and sensual undertones, has become an integral part of the Stones' repertoire, showcasing.
